description: WHITE CHOCOLATE STUFFED COOKIES 🤍🍪 Makes 6 large cookies (about 4 oz / 113 g each) INGREDIENTS: • ¾ cup (170 g) salted butter, softened • ¾ cup (150 g) brown sugar • ⅓ cup (65 g) granulated sugar • 1 large egg • 2 tsp vanilla extract • 2 ¼ cups (270 g) all-purpose flour • 1 ½ tbsp (12 g) cornstarch • ⅓ tsp baking soda • ⅓ tsp salt • White chocolate chips, as desired • White chocolate chunks, for filling + topping HOW TO MAKE: Cream the butter and both sugars together until light and smooth. Mix in the egg and vanilla until everything comes together. Pour in the flour, cornstarch, baking soda, and salt. Mix only until you no longer see dry flour — keeping the mixing minimal helps the cookies stay tender. Stir white chocolate chips throughout the dough. Portion the dough into 6 pieces, approximately 4 oz (113 g) each. Press a piece of white chocolate into the middle of each portion, close the dough around it, and form a thick, tall cookie dough ball. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet with enough room for spreading. Finish each cookie with a few white chocolate chunks on top. Bake at 375°F (190°C) for about 12–14 minutes. Take them out when the edges have just started turning golden and the centers still look soft.
